verdict.rationale: Kit documents per-broadcast stats covering recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes and their rates, plus per-link click performance and batch stats across a page of broadcasts. Over-time data is limited to account-level 90-day email stats, growth stats for a chosen period, and 5-year email stats retention. There is no evidence of stats per automation or sequence step, and none of conversion tracking per campaign. missing for 10: per-automation-step/sequence-email analytics, conversion attribution per campaign, per-campaign time-series trends, independent/hands-on corroboration.
